layout.hierarchy: The title is the largest text (red, bold). The five process boxes are the visual dominant elements due to saturated fills and bold black labels; 'Classification' stands out most as the only box with a dark fill and white text. Gray sub-labels are smallest. Ellipses (Training Data, Final Result) act as start/end terminals.

visual_elements.description: Linear pipeline of 5 stages with start/end terminals. Nodes and connections: (1) Ellipse 'Training Data' (peach fill, thin dark outline) -> curved red arrow down-right into (2) Rectangle 'Pre processing' (pale yellow fill, blue border, two-line text) -> straight red arrow -> (3) Rectangle 'Feature Extraction' (pale cyan fill, blue border, two-line text) -> straight red arrow -> (4) Rectangle 'Feature Selection' (pale green fill, green border, two-line text) -> straight red arrow -> (5) Rectangle 'Classification' (dark red fill, white bold text, single line) -> straight red arrow -> (6) Rectangle 'Post processing' (pale purple/lavender fill, purple border, two-line text) -> curved red arrow down -> (7) Ellipse 'Final Result' (bright yellow fill, black border). Beneath stages 1-4 sit four small gray rounded-corner rectangles aligned under their respective boxes: 'Cleaned Data' under Pre processing, 'Feature Vectors' under Feature Extraction, 'Final Features' under Feature Selection, 'Predicted Class' under Classification. These gray boxes are not connected by arrows; they annotate each stage's output. A small white mouse-pointer cursor with black outline overlaps the right edge of the 'Classification' box (video cursor overlay, not slide content).

Box labels are bold black, roughly equal size across the five process boxes; 'Classification' is bold white on dark red. Gray output labels are bold black but smaller than box labels. Ellipse labels ('Training Data', 'Final Result') are bold black, two lines for 'Training Data' and 'Final Result' is single line. No italics, no all-caps, no numbered or bulleted lists anywhere.

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#E8E8E8). 2. Add title text box, top-center: 'The Complete ML Classification Process', bold sans-serif, ~32-36pt, red (#CC0000). 3. Inside the panel top-left, insert an oval (~14% wide) filled peach (#F5CBA7) with thin dark outline; add two-line bold black text 'Training Data'. 5. Create five rectangles in a horizontal row at mid-panel height, each ~11-13% wide, with two-line bold black centered text except where noted: 'Pre processing' (fill #FFFFCC, blue border), 'Feature Extraction' (fill #CCFFFF, blue border), 'Feature Selection' (fill #E5FFE5, green border), 'Classification' (fill #B02020, single-line bold WHITE text), 'Post processing' (fill #E0CCF0, purple border). 6. Connect the five rectangles left-to-right with straight red (#CC0000) block arrows. 7. Add a curved red arrow from the bottom of the 'Training Data' ellipse to the left edge of 'Pre processing'. 8. Add a curved red arrow from the bottom of 'Post processing' down-right to a yellow (#FFFF00) oval with black border labeled 'Final Result' (bold black, single line), placed at bottom-right of the panel. 9. Below the chain, add four small gray (#D9D9D9) rounded rectangles with two-line bold black text, aligned under their stages: 'Cleaned Data' (under Pre processing), 'Feature Vectors' (under Feature Extraction), 'Final Features' (under Feature Selection), 'Predicted Class' (under Classification); no arrows attach to these. 10. Optionally add a solid black rectangle strip across the very bottom edge of the slide to match the source frame. 11. Do not add bullets, equations, or footnotes; the slide contains none.
